scope: Exact finite coefficients for RN mask weights, union source/label marginal domination, and original dyadic source-only entropy range. Not an actual FIRST or geometric fixture.
checker_epsilon: 1/4096, a pre-fixed rational coefficient threshold only, not a certified value of theory epsilon
independent_RN_model: At most 8,16,32 supported soft mask coordinates in the three rounds, other coordinates hardpersistent; finite positive coefficient model only.
union_marginal_models: Rational low/high label weights and envelope S>=averaged response, with source-high, source-low label-high, equality-paid and strict-low branches. No inference of actual continuous FIRST.
source_entropy_models: Exactly compressed full-born uniform 2^n-child node and explicit binary depth sum, not actual output or history samples.
forbidden_claims: finite future nodes certify original full cap
cutoff_search: Exact monotone binary search only inside the registered interval 0..4alpha+64; if last weight remains below checker epsilon report a strict lower bound, not an invented exact cutoff. Whole-range existence is analytic.
equality_checker: Additional rational epsilon_eq=w_1(sigma) to check label equality is paid, explicitly distinct from both fixed checker epsilon and theoretical epsilon.
